title: Build a Min-Heap by Inserting
summary: Build a min-heap by adding values one at a time at the bottom of a complete binary tree and swapping each one upward while it is smaller than its parent, so the smallest value always ends at the root.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values to insert (in order)
inputs.note: The values are arranged as a complete binary tree: index i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2.

anchors.label: Add the next value at the bottom
Compare the parent with the child
